explication: Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor. The main user workflow is opening a project, editing and navigating code in a workspace, and optionally collaborating or using AI assistance; debugging and extension-backed integrations are important parallel capabilities. The tree identifies these subsystems, but most implementation excerpts are absent, so the graph keeps cross-module wiring sparse. The sampled project connection manager uses the client for remote-project reconnection, and the sampled workspace history manager reads and updates persisted workspace history.
